name: lookprep
description: Plan a lip filler consultation: explain named lip looks, compare looks and amounts on stored demo simulations, check prices, and hand an adult to LookPrep to make their own simulation. Read-only; no photo, consent or payment passes through it.

interface.longDescription: LookPrep makes simulations of how lip filler might look: from one photo of a person's own face, it shows named lip looks and a lip flip at set amounts, side by side, to take to a consultation. This plugin teaches the agent to explain what look names such as Russian, cupid's bow or heart-shaped lips usually describe and where sources disagree, to compare looks and amounts on stored demo simulations, to quote current prices, and to give the person a link to make their own simulation on lookprep.com. The person uploads their own photo and confirms they are 18 or older there, themselves, and can pay, if they choose, on LookPrep's checkout page. The tools are read-only and need no account: they never take a photo, consent, payment details or an email address, and nothing is generated when they are called. A simulation is for planning and discussion, for adults 18 or older: not a prediction of a result and not medical advice.
capabilities: Explain named lip filler looks and where sources disagree
Compare looks and amounts on stored demo simulations
Link a person to make their own simulation on lookprep.com
defaultPrompt: What do Russian lips and cupid's bow lips each mean?
Show me natural lips at two amounts on a demo face, side by side.
I want to see these looks on my own face before my consultation. Where do I start?
